name: status
description: Check the MIDI port, loopMIDI and Character Animator, and list the saved trigger mappings (name -> note/CC).

name: map_trigger
description: Save a friendly name for a MIDI note (a trigger: swap, gesture, expression) or a CC (a parameter slider/dial). Omit note and cc to get the next free note from C2 up. remove=true deletes the mapping.

note.description: 0-127 or a name like C3, F#2 (C4 = 60).

name: learn
description: Send a mapping's note (or a CC sweep) so Character Animator can capture it: first have the user click the trigger's or parameter's MIDI field in Character Animator so it is waiting for input.

name: trigger
description: Fire a trigger: note on, hold, note off. Use a mapped name or a note. hold_ms keeps it pressed (for hold triggers); repeat fires it several times.

name: note
description: Press (on=true, default) or release (on=false) a note and leave it there, for triggers that should stay held across other actions.

name: control
description: Set a MIDI controller (CC) to a value 0-127, moving the Character Animator parameter linked to it.

name: ramp
description: Move a CC smoothly from one value to another over time (linear or ease_in_out), e.g. a slow head turn.

name: perform
description: Play a timed sequence (up to 10 min), e.g. while Character Animator records. steps = [{at_ms, action: trigger|note|control|ramp, ...that action's fields}]. Example: [{"at_ms":0,"name":"smile"},{"at_ms":1200,"name":"wave","hold_ms":800},{"at_ms":2500,"action":"ramp","name":"head_turn","from":64,"to":110,"duration_ms":600}].

name: panic
description: Release everything: All Notes Off and Reset Controllers on every channel.
